messages:
Maya (CS): Quick capture from today's onboarding with SolaraTech — finance and platform both raised three consistent asks: per-route billing breakdown, the ability to pin an embedding model per-route, and a tiny onboarding checklist with starter prompts. They said the lack of per-route numbers is blocking internal chargebacks and seat expansion.

Ben (PM): Can you paste verbatim lines and which routes they care about? helps prioritize.

Maya (CS): Verbatim snippets: 
- "We need per-endpoint cost so we can allocate to our teams."
- "If embedding spend spikes we need a way to lock to a cheaper model for search routes."
- "A one-page checklist with example prompts would have cut our setup time."
They called out `triage-summarize` and `kb-embeds-search`. Reported in 3 onboarding sessions.

Clara (Product): My triage: 1) Checklist + prompts = immediate low-effort win (ship this week). 2) Per-route CSV export = short-term stopgap. 3) Embed-pin per-route = medium effort but high ROI. 4) Full per-route billing UI = roadmap item.

Raj (Eng): For the CSV stopgap we need to propagate route_id into billing aggregation and add an authenticated endpoint to download per-route totals. Rough estimate: 2 dev days for CSV pipeline + endpoint; embedding-pin likely ~3 dev days (metadata + runtime lookup). Full UI will be multi-sprint. Sample ad-hoc query we can run now: 

SELECT route_id, DATE(ts) day, SUM(cost_cents) total_cents
FROM billing_events
WHERE account_id='solaratech' AND ts >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY route_id, day;

Maya (CS): I'll open a cs:feedback ticket and attach the call snippets. Recommend marking SolaraTech as at-risk if we don't provide an interim CSV within 8 business days. Also requesting a one-pager enablement slide for CSMs.

Ben (PM): Action items: Maya opens ticket with quotes + routes; Product owns checklist; Eng scopes CSV + embed-pin and posts estimates. I'll flag CSV as P0 quick-win for retention.

OpsBot: JIRA ticket CS-7011 created by Maya (CS) - "SolaraTech onboarding: per-route billing CSV + embed-pin + checklist" - https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/CS-7011

Raj (Eng): Adding CS-7011 to sprint buffer; will post sample CSV and PR link here when ready.

Clara (Product): Drafting checklist and starter prompts now, will share in this thread for CS signoff by EOD.

Maya (CS): Thanks team 60a I'll update SolaraTech with the interim timeline and track renewal risk.
